name: Deepak Nitrite Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1970, Deepak Nitrite Ltd manufactures Basic Intermediates, Fine & Speciality Chemicals, Performance Products, and Phenolics [1]
key_points: Business Segments: [1] The company is one of the fastest growing chemical intermediates companies in India with a portfolio of 36+ products and 56+ applications, divided into 2 segments: a) Phenolics (68% in FY26 vs 70% in FY25): [2] [3] [4] The company produces Cumene, Phenol, Acetone, Isopropyl Alcohol, Alpha Methyl Styrene (AMS), etc., catering to industries like laminates & plywood, automotive, construction, pharmaceuticals, and adhesives. It is the largest producer of Phenol and Acetone in India with a 50% market share . b) Advanced Intermediates (32% in FY26 vs 30% in FY25): [5] [6] The company manufactures Nitrites, Nitro Toluidines, Xylidines, Oxyimes, Cumidines, Optical Brightening Agents (OBA), DASDA, etc., serving industries like colorants, dyes, rubber, paper, agrochemicals, pharmaceuticals, water treatment, etc. It is India's largest producer of Sodium Nitrite and ranks among the top 3 global manufacturers of Xylidines and Oximes .

profile.summary: Deepak Nitrite Limited manufactures, trades, and sells chemical intermediates in India and internationally. It operates through Advanced Intermediates and Phenolics segments. The company offers sodium nitrite, sodium nitrate, nitro toluidines, fuel additives, nitrosylsulfuric acid, xylidines, oximes, cumidines, speciality agrochemicals, optical brighteners, nitric acid, fluorinated compounds, DASDA, benzotrifluoride, cumene, phenol, acetone, isopropyl alcohol, and alpha methyl styrene. It also provides 2 MePPDA, 2,3-xylidine, 2,4-xylidine, 2,6-xylidine, 2-ethylhexyl nitrate, 3-NOX, 4-NOX; 2B, 4BBT, ABP, ABP X, and BMK deepwhite powders; 2BL, ABP, AS, BA, BHT HC, DSP, MST, SPF Z, SI, UBR, UP, and XBE deepwhite liquids; 4BB conc, 4BB conc T, DMA-X, DMA-X conc, and UFD slurry deepwhite products; IPA, MAHCL, mHBTF, MMDPA, MNT(3- nitrotoluene), MT(m-toluidine), ONT(2- nitrotoluene), OT(o-toluidine), PNT(4- nitrotoluene), and PT(p-toluidine); B+ (brown colour), FX (yellow colour), and GLP (yellow colour) protecto products; ortho and para cumidines; and TFMAP, as well as project management consultancy services and manufactures polycarbonate compounds. The company serves colourants, dyes, rubber, paper, agrochemicals, pharmaceuticals, personal care, water treatment, glass, explosives, textiles, laminate and plywood, automotive, construction, adhesives, and sanitisers industries. Deepak Nitrite Limited was incorporated in 1970 and is headquartered in Vadodara, India.
